headline: Saints' Tyson has 1st practice since injury, feels 'more explosive' than ever

sources.name: ESPN
sources.headline: Saints' Tyson has 1st practice since injury, feels 'more explosive' than ever
sources.description: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Saints WR Jordyn Tyson feels "more explosive than I ever have" in return from hamstring injury
sources.description: The Saints can use all the help they can get after a 2-5 start to the season and one ray of hope is the return of rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson to the practice field this week.

sources.headline: Jordyn Tyson listed as questionable to make Saints debut this week
sources.description: Saints first-round pick Jordyn Tyson could make his regular season debut against the Browns on Sunday, but the team will wait to make a final determination on his status.
